instructions:
Read the notice.

Extracted facts
Consider every field below. Include each supported fact once. For text, give its field and exact quote only. For all other kinds, give field, value and exact quote. Omit unsupported facts. Output labels classify evidence; they do not decide eligibility.
text: Return only the exact passage that is the field value, in its original language. Do not translate titles; display translations are generated separately.
url: Copy one exact public URL supplied in notice_links.
date: Use the buyer's local calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD; cite the date with its deadline context.
money: Supply a plain non-negative decimal with no grouping or currency symbol. The quote must explicitly give that amount in EUR or euros (€).
bool: Use the string "true" or "false" only when the notice explicitly establishes the requirement or exemption.
label: Select one exact allowed label supported by the quote.
label-list: Encode the applicable allowed labels as a JSON array inside the value string, e.g. ["architecture"].
title (text): Required whenever a title is stated. Copy and quote the full notice_title when available. Otherwise find and quote the original project title in notice_text.
organizer (text): Named body organizing the competition or commissioning the work.
authority_name (text): Contracting authority or buyer as named in the notice.
official_url (url): Public notice or project page for this specific commission.
location_label (text): Project site or address as written, excluding the buyer's office.
location_city (text): City or municipality of the project site.
location_region (text): Region, province or state of the project site.
deadline_at (date): Deadline for submitting the tender, entry or application. Put other milestones in timeline excerpts.
registration_fee_eur (money): Fee to register, including zero only when explicitly priced in euros.
submission_fee_eur (money): Fee to submit an entry or tender.
estimated_contract_value_eur (money): Estimated value of the commissioned contract, distinct from the construction budget.
estimated_contract_value_text (text): Original wording for the contract value, retaining currency and qualifications.
prize_summary (text): Original wording for prizes or awards.
eligibility_summary (text): A short verbatim clause stating who may participate.
brief_pdf_url (url): Public link to the project brief PDF.
documents_portal_url (url): Portal supplying this project's tender or competition documents.
opportunity_type (label): Kind of design commission being offered. Allowed: public_design_contest, public_design_services_procurement, framework_design_services, negotiated_follow_on_services
procedure_type (label): Procurement or competition procedure stated by the buyer. Allowed: design_contest, negotiated_procedure_after_contest, public_design_services_tender, maitrise_d_oeuvre_procurement, planning_competition, selective, framework_agreement, negotiated_procedure, adapted_procedure, open, neg-w-call, neg-wo-call
implementation_path (label): How selection leads to a commission or follow-on contract. Allowed: winner_or_winners_progress_to_negotiated_service_award, service_contract_award_after_competitive_selection, framework_selection_for_repeated_design_commissions, unknown
licensed_architect_required (bool): Whether professional architect registration is explicitly required.
local_partner_required (bool): Whether a local partner is explicitly required.
competition_types (label-list): Architectural disciplines or competition themes. Allowed: architecture, urban_design, landscape, interior, adaptive_reuse, built_work, housing, pavilion, masterplan, public_building, healthcare, education, infrastructure
project_types (label-list): Nature of the design project. Allowed: urban_regeneration, environment_design, urban_planning, interior_project, building_project
building_categories (label-list): Functions of the buildings involved. Allowed: healthcare, education, housing, civic_public, sport_leisure, culture_heritage, transport_infrastructure
design_scopes (label-list): Design services and phases included in the commission. Allowed: interior_design, architectural_design, scheme, preliminary, construction_docs, planning, design_service
project_modes (label-list): Whether the physical works are new build, renovation or extension. Allowed: new_build, renovation, extension
audience (label-list): Eligible participant groups described by the notice. Allowed: students, young_architects, professionals, open, multidisciplinary
jurisdiction (label): Project jurisdiction supported by the notice. Allowed: global, europe, asia, north_america, oceania, australia, canada, china, italy, france, germany, new_zealand, netherlands, norway, poland, sweden, portugal, belgium, spain, switzerland, united_kingdom, austria, iberia, nordics, middle_east, united_arab_emirates, saudi_arabia, qatar, oman, bahrain, kuwait, jordan, turkiye, egypt
languages (label-list): Languages explicitly specified for participation or submission. Allowed: en, it, es, fr, de, nl, pl, sv, no, pt, ca, gl, eu, zh, ar, tr
official_notice_id (text): Identifier assigned to the notice by the issuing authority.
